Allow.description: GET, HEAD, OPTIONS for this resource.

ETag.description: Strong validator of exact successful JSON bytes.

WWW-Authenticate.description: Bearer challenge with optional OAuth error.

Problem.description: RFC 9457; absent when the error format is unacceptable. Missing credentials produce a bodyless Bearer challenge.

Bearer.description: Opaque local token or Cloud Run identity token.

info.description: Private read-only Momentum catalogue. UTC dates/timestamps; finite JSON. Lists are ordered by created_at DESC, id DESC, with filter-bound keyset tokens and no snapshot guarantee under concurrent updates. Latest selects one winner per ticker before rating filters. Unknown ticker returns an empty page. GET/HEAD bodies and duplicate or unknown query parameters are rejected. Error types: https://github.com/kaligautier/trading-on-IBKR-with-ADK-/blob/main/apps/backend/momentum-api/README.md#invalid-argument, invalid-request, invalid-token, not-found, method-not-allowed, not-acceptable, precondition-failed, invalid-stored-data, configuration-error, store-unavailable, internal-error, not-implemented
info.title: Momentum consultation API
